name: Weighted Order-Independent Transparency for 3DGS
definition: A rendering equation for 3D Gaussians that uses a learnable weight function $w_i$ to handle transparency without sorting, defined in [22] and adopted from [14].
summary: Weighted Order-Independent Transparency for 3DGS renders transparent scenes without depth sorting by using a learnable weight function to approximate correct blending, eliminating the sorting step required by standard rasterization.
